prompt: Which two MLB teams played in the World Series just weeks after the O.J. Simpson murder trial had ended?
answer: The **Atlanta Braves and Cleveland Indians** played in the 1995 World Series, which began on October 21, just over two weeks after O.J. Simpson was acquitted on October 3. The Braves won the series, four games to two.
